mapper.select: SELECT id, driver_record_id, storage_name, content_type, file_size, width, height, display_order, created_at FROM driver_record_photo WHERE driver_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY display_order, id

SELECT photo.id, photo.driver_record_id, photo.storage_name, photo.content_type, photo.file_size, photo.width, photo.height, photo.display_order, photo.created_at FROM driver_record_photo photo INNER JOIN driver_record record ON record.id = photo.driver_record_id AND record.deleted = 0 WHERE photo.id = #{id}
